description: Unofficial Three fan-art animated companion inspired by Battle for Dream Island. The red numeral keeps its anatomical-right white eye cover and normal readable shape. Original animation includes handling three paper balls, aligning three blank tiles, folding a soft paper flag and recovering a drooping flag, plus short steps and a hop. Smooth drawn surfaces replace plush fabric; paper, foam and rounded props are gentle display adaptations. Not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
